observations: This underside sequence rotates the pot and the visible foliage clusters substantially in the image. B keeps a connected near-circular pot silhouette throughout all 33 frames and preserves surrounding leaf-cluster outlines, whose local boundaries change and merge.

C retains a useful near-circular pot-base curve through the sequence, with a persistent gap and adjacent outer fragments. Its broad position follows the pot, but most surrounding leaves and pot-rim ribbing are missing. Small fragments and gaps vary between frames.
A retains only partial outer-pot arcs and sparse canopy marks; the missing side changes with the projected rotation, and the whole plant remains incomplete. D remains mostly point-like.
Local persistence of a pot-base curve is useful but does not establish whole-frame legibility or fewer defects at comparable ink. The pages do not support an independent perceptual stability claim.
review_mode: All decoded video frames inspected sequentially in ordered contact pages, with full-frame source quartiles; not timed playback perception.
scope: internal implementing-model review; randomized labels observed before opening key; not independent validation
